## Root cause (now documented in the file's own comment, lines 22-28 on origin/main)

The polluter formerly carried, at module level:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(repo_root() / "scripts"))
task_workflow.repo_root() branch-guards to the MAIN checkout, so a worktree-run pytest
session leaked a FOREIGN checkout's scripts/ onto sys.path for the whole session. The #1296
negative control in test_backend_poll.py scrubs only entries resolving to the LOCAL tree's
scripts/, so the leaked entry survived the scrub and a bare runpod_api import still resolved
-> "DID NOT RAISE ModuleNotFoundError".
